decisions.reason: The cutting and creasing finisher sits close to the core Multigraf line, costs little to keep as a distributed product, and supports the modular finishing offer the firm has built its reputation on.

The firm publicly staged a German premiere for the UV spot varnishing system and frames it as a flagship of its push into embellishment, so slow early uptake is likely blamed on a temporary market ramp-up rather than seen as grounds to drop it.
The sheet preparation module complements the existing systems, so keeping it costs little and keeps the modular workflow offer intact.
The B2 multifinisher is a home-page flagship tied to the core Duplo partnership and the firm's automation direction, so its visible strategic commitment strongly favors persistence.
The folding add-on has a documented customer installation combined with the core creasing system, which gives results that justify keeping it.
